item.title: [Palace Films] BUTTERFLY - Official HD Trailer - Only In Cinemas
item.description:
© Palace Films

The brilliant Renate Reinsve (‘The Worst Person in the World’, ‘Sentimental Value’, ‘Fjord’) leads Itonje Søimer Guttormsen’s BUTTERFLY, an intriguing and mystical drama about two estranged sisters who reunite in Gran Canaria after the sudden, mysterious death of their mother.

Half-sisters Diana (Helene Bjørneby) and Lily (Reinsve) grew up as the only resident children at an all-inclusive resort in the Canary Islands, where their uninhibited mother, Vera, worked as a tour guide. Twenty-five years later, they are estranged, having both actively sought distance from the island and from each other.

Forced back to the island together, they must confront the aftermath of Vera’s death at an esoteric mountain retreat, where she had tried to build a spiritual world far removed from the island’s package-tour veneer.

item.title: [Palace Films] THE LAST VIKING - Official HD Trailer - Only In Cinemas
item.description:
http://www.palacefilms.com.au/the-last-viking © Palace Films

WINNER – 2026 ROBERT (DANISH ACADEMY) AWARDS – Audience Award
OFFICIAL SELECTION – 2025 VENICE INTERNATIONAL FILM FESTIVAL
OFFICIAL SELECTION – 2025 TORONTO INTERNATIONAL FILM FESTIVAL

The great Mads Mikkelsen ('Another Round') and Nikolaj Lie Kaas ('Department Q') lean into the mayhem in the outrageous new black comedy from award-winning writer-director Anders Thomas Jensen ('Riders of Justice', 'Adam’s Apples'). It follows a bank robber who must unlock his brother’s lost memory to recover long-buried heist money.
Rural Denmark, present day.

Anker (Lie Kaas), a career criminal with dreams of a never-ending holiday somewhere sunny, is released from prison after a fifteen-year sentence. Before he was put away, Anker pressured his brother Manfred (Mikkelsen) to hide the stolen money near their mother’s home, and only Manfred knows where it is. But while Anker has been behind bars, Manfred has developed an alter ego - convinced he’s John Lennon - and has forgotten the money ever existed. With the help of a psychologist, the brothers set out to recover the loot, but their journey spirals into something far stranger - and more revealing - than they ever expected…

For all its outlandishness and unpredictability, THE LAST VIKING finds genuine empathy amidst the dark humour, emerging as a warm-hearted comedy about identity and how we’re shaped by the stories others tell about us, and the ones we choose for ourselves.

Directed and co-written by Maria Sødahl, THE LAST RESORT is an absorbing drama about a Danish family forced to reassess their moral compass during a dream holiday in the Canary Islands.

When Mikkel (Espen Smed) and Louise (Danica Ćurčić) set off on a well-deserved charter holiday with their two daughters, they have only one goal: to enjoy a carefree week together after a long stretch of everyday pressures. But beyond their all-inclusive bubble, another reality unfolds, as thousands arrive by sea in search of a better life. When they encounter a man in need, they choose to help. As his requests grow and their involvement deepens, their good intentions begin to give way to fear for their own safety.

item.title: [Palace Films] THE LOVE THAT REMAINS - Official HD Trailer - Only in Cinemas
item.description:
http://www.palacefilms.com.au/the-love-that-remains © Palace Films

From award-winning writer/director Hlynur Pálmason ('Godland', 'A White, White Day') – one of cinema’s most singular contemporary artists – THE LOVE THAT REMAINS tenderly and hilariously captures a year in the life of a family of five, as the parents navigate their separation.

Though in the throes of a splitting up, Anna (Saga Garðarsdóttir) and Magnus (Sverrir Gudnason) still spend time together for the sake of their three children, Ída and twins Þorgils and Grímur (played, remarkably, by the three real-life children of director Pálmason). Magnus works at sea, infrequently returning to land, where he asserts himself as the patriarch with limited efficacy. Anna is an artist whose vast and impressive works fail to receive suitable recognition. In their interactions, whilst there's sufficient indication of why the separation is happening, there's also the familiarity of a long-held love and a glimmer of a chance of reconciliation...

Often taking playful and laugh-out-loud diversions, Pálmason's deeply felt film conveys so much love for its characters and the gorgeous Icelandic environment, delivering a soulful look at the importance of family and shared memories amidst the changing seasons.

item.title: [Palace Films] NARCISO - Official HD Trailer - Only In Cinemas
item.description:
http://www.palacefilms.com.au/narciso © Palace Films 2026

WINNER - 2026 BERLIN FILM FESTIVAL (Panorama) – FIPRESCI Prize for Best Film

Inspired by notorious real-life events, the seductive new noir from multi award-winning writer/director Marcelo Martinessi ('The Heiresses') unravels the mysterious death of a charismatic radio host in late-1950s Paraguay — as the rebellious pulse of rock ’n’ roll crackling over the airwaves sparks fear, scandal and a national moral panic.

Asunción, 1959. Under dictator Alfredo Stroessner’s tightening military regime, magnetic young DJ Narciso Arévalos (a captivating Diro Romero) is found dead after his provocative final broadcast. His popularity has risen in tandem with the arrival of imported American music, which Narciso – having returned from Buenos Aires energised by the likes of Chuck Berry and Buddy Holly - has convinced the station’s repressed owner Lulú (Manuel Cuenca) to play in place of traditional Paraguayan folk standards. Filmed live before an adoring crowd, Narciso’s show ignites a generation craving freedom. Yet his defiant allure also earns powerful, dangerous attention, and stirs envy among the fearful...

Visually stunning and immersive, Martinessi’s atmospheric thriller probes how desire, fear, and shared beliefs work together to sustain dictatorships. Sounding a warning from the past that resonates amid today’s authoritarian resurgence, NARCISO reminds us that few forces challenge conformity more powerfully than art — especially the electrifying sound of rock ’n’ roll.

item.title: [Palace Films] LA SALSA VIVE - Official HD Trailer - Only In Cinemas
item.description:
http://www.palacefilms.com.au/la-salsa-vive © Palace Films 2026

OFFICIAL SELECTION - 2026 SPANISH & LATIN AMERICAN FILM FESTIVAL
OFFICIAL SELECTION – 2025 SXSW FILM FESTIVAL

In the tradition of 'The Buena Vista Social Club', Juan Carvajal’s joyful debut LA SALSA VIVE ('Salsa Lives') is a vibrant cinematic exploration of a musical movement that has ignited generations, salsa, weaving stories from its origins in 1960s New York City, USA, to its contemporary thriving scene in Cali, Colombia.

Born from the rich, interwoven sounds of the Caribbean, salsa emerged in New York as a powerful cultural force, bringing dozens of Latin American musical traditions under one umbrella. As its popularity shifted over time, salsa found a fervent new home in Cali, where it continues to thrive with unmatched energy across dance schools, nightclubs, orchestras, and the city’s spirited neighbourhoods.

Blending remarkable archival footage, live recordings and illuminating interviews with legends including singers Rubén Blades and Henry Fiol, percussionists Samuel Formell and Johnny "Dandy" Rodríguez, and 100-year-old maestro Willie Rosario, LA SALSA VIVE captures both the history and enduring pulse of salsa. Celebrating devoted dancers, music collectors, and a new generation embracing its rhythms, the film - a smash hit at the Colombian box office - is an exhilarating love letter to a vivid and living cultural legacy.

item.title: [Palace Films] BERLIN HERO - Official HD Trailer - Only In Cinemas
item.description:
http://www.palacefilms.com.au/berlin-hero © Palace Films 2026

OPENING NIGHT SELECTION - 2026 GERMAN FILM FESTIVAL

The final film from Wolfgang Becker ('Good Bye, Lenin!'), completed shortly before his passing, BERLIN HERO is a sharp, bittersweet satire adapted from Maxim Leo’s 2022 novel about an ordinary man swept up in an extraordinary lie.

Berlin, 2019. As the city marks 30 years since the fall of the Wall, Micha Hartung (Charly Hübner) is barely getting by, running - and living in - a failing video store. But when a magazine journalist (Leon Ullrich) uncovers a long-forgotten incident from his past, everything changes. As a railway worker in the German Democratic Republic, Micha once mistakenly sent a train across the border into the West. Reimagined as a bold act of defiance, the story is spun into a media sensation, casting Micha as the mastermind behind the biggest mass escape in GDR history. Reluctant at first, Micha is soon caught in the glare of fame – which also has its perks, as he meets his dream woman, Paula (Christiane Paul). He never imagined an ordinary guy like him could attract someone so successful, educated and witty, but like the rest of his life, this budding love story threatens to descend into a chaos of miscommunication and lies.

Blending satire with emotional nuance, BERLIN HERO features a standout ensemble including Jürgen Vogel, Daniel Brühl, Thorsten Merten and Peter Kurth, delivering a distinctly German comedy with bite and charm.

item.title: [Palace Films] MY FRIEND EVA - Official HD Trailer - Only In Cinemas
item.description:
http://www.palacefilms.com.au/my-friend-eva © Palace Films 2026

The effervescent, crowd-pleasing new comedy from Cesc Gay ('Truman', 'A Gun In Each Hand', and 'The People Upstairs', which recently formed the basis for Olivia Wilde’s 'The Invite') stars a luminous Nora Navas ('Pain & Glory') as a middle-aged woman who dares to disrupt her carefully constructed life in pursuit of one last, intoxicating chance at romance.

On a business trip in Rome, Eva (Navas), on the cusp of turning 50, shares a fleeting but electric encounter with Argentine screenwriter Álex (Rodrigo de la Serna, 'The Motorcycle Diaries', 'Money Heist'). The connection rekindles something long dormant - desire, spontaneity, and the dizzying thrill of possibility. Back in Barcelona with her husband (Juan Diego Botto, 'The Room Next Door') and teenage children, Eva finds herself unable to return to the rhythms of her former life. As the pull of this unexpected awakening intensifies, Eva makes a radical choice that blindsides her family and friendships, forcing everyone around her to confront their own ideas of love, loyalty, and reinvention.

Witty, perceptive, and deeply humane, MY FRIEND EVA explores the pitfalls of choosing passion over stability, and the complicated, often comic realities of starting over when life is already well underway.

item.title: [The Match Factory] Rose | Trailer | Markus Schleinzer | Sandra Hüller
item.description:
Amidst the turmoil of the Thirty Years´ War, somewhere in Germany, a mysterious soldier appears in a secluded Protestant village. Small and quiet, his face disfigured by a scar, this stranger declares himself the heir of a long-abandoned farmstead and produces a document to support his claim to the suspicious villagers. With time, he overcomes their doubts and shows himself to be a hard-working, God-fearing man, becoming part of the community in a quest for acceptance made up of impossible deceit. The true and twisted tale of a deceiver of land and folk, who, defying her birth as a woman, comported herself as a man and comitted many a wicked deed.

item.title: [The Match Factory] Projecto Global | Trailer | Ivo M. Ferreira | Jani Zhao | Rodrigo Tomás | José Pimentão
item.description:
Lisbon, 1980s: the Carnation Revolution and the euphoria of freedom belong to the past. The country faces turbulent times: factories close, workers raise barricades, and politics dominates every street corner. Amid cigarette smoke, music, prostitutes, and sailors, people share shattered dreams and uncertain hopes.
As social tensions deepen, the far-left armed group FP25 emerges.
Its members follow a path of no return, living underground lives built on bank robberies, attacks, friendship, family, and love — all under the perpetual threat of prison or death.
As they abandon everything and everyone except each other, they begin to lose their own identities, while an officer fighting against them faces a moral dilemma of his own.

item.title: [The Match Factory] Nuestra Tierra | Trailer | Lucrecia Martel
item.description:
In October 2009, Javier Chocobar, a member of the indigenous Chuchagasta community in northwest Argentina’s Tucumán Province, tried to defend himself and his people from being forcibly evicted from their land by a local landowner and two former police officers. As a result, the 68-year-old Chocobar was shot and killed, and two other community members were wounded. In her expansive and enlightening first feature documentary, Argentinean filmmaker Lucrecia Martel (Zama, 2017) takes a sweeping approach to this tragic true story, triangulating the murder trial of the three men, the lives of Chocobar and his fellow Chuchagasta people, and the centuries-old, colonialist legacy of land and property theft across Latin America. With a ravishing, at times vertiginous visual approach to filming the natural beauty of the contested land, Martel pays cinematic tribute to people whom others systematically tried to erase from history.

(Synopsis courtesy of New York Film Festival)

item.title: [The Match Factory] Agon | Trailer | Giulio Bertelli | Yile Yara Vianello | Alice Bellandi | Sofija Zobina
item.description:
As the fictional Olympic Games of Ludoj 2024 approaches, AGON shows the stories of three athletes as they prepare and then compete in rifle shooting, fencing and judo. These women are portrayed against the political, social, technological and physical contexts that dominate the highest level of sports competition and performance. Informed by the historical figures of Joan of Arc, Cleopatra and Russian cavalry officer Nadezhda Durova, AGON explores a contemporary account of the contradictions of these sports, which began as a practice for wartime in peacetime, evolved into professional sports and entertainment, and in recent times embrace video games to create a new form of competitive sport.

item.title: [The Match Factory] Below The Clouds | Trailer | Gianfranco Rosi
item.description:
Between Mount Vesuvius and the Gulf of Naples, the ground shakes periodically and the fumaroles of the Phlegraean Fields taint the air. From the traces of history, memories of the subterranean world, and the concerns of the present, in black and white, a lesser-known Naples emerges and fills with voices, with lives. Below the clouds lies a territory crisscrossed by locals, worshippers, tourists, and archaeologists excavating a past that in museums will give new life and meaning to statues, fragments, and ruins. The train that rings Vesuvius makes its rounds as racehorses train along the shore. A teacher runs a makeshift afterschool for children and adolescents. Firemen in their command center calm the fears of the locals who call in, law enforcement tracks down tomb robbers, while in the port of Torre Annunziata, Syrian tankers unload Ukrainian grain. The land that skirts the gulf is a vast time machine.
